name: myfirstproject
description: Monorepo con web Next.js y API Express, desplegado en Netlify.

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:api
scripts.check: npm run check:web && npm run check:api
scripts.build:netlify: npm run prisma:generate --workspace @myfirstproject/api && npm run prisma:migrate:deploy --workspace @myfirstproject/api && npm run build:web
